plan.selection: All fixed beforehand; no fitting or threshold search. Risk0 and RMS from prior frozen parameters.

timing.fixed_reference: Native free round0 token IDs excluding its single synthetic BOS; all other generated tokens retained, including EOS. Never score forced answers as quality.

plan.acceptance: All four native-minus-candidate losses <=.10; positive scene-cluster bootstrap 95% lower CI of fixed-token request savings, all round means positive, all scene means positive, and Risk0 not Pareto-dominated by RMS in four losses vs fixed-token model compute.

bootstrap.unit: scene, pooling repeated measurements within each scene before resampling

rms.budget_units: absolute score loss: native minus candidate; not relative percent
rms.scope: OFFICIAL EVALUATOR ON DECLARED SUBSET, NOT full-val mAP/NDS/Map Score
rms.limitations: Numeric/spatial/motion/safety parsers are lexical proxies, not human semantic judgements

risk0.budget_units: absolute score loss: native minus candidate; not relative percent
risk0.scope: OFFICIAL EVALUATOR ON DECLARED SUBSET, NOT full-val mAP/NDS/Map Score
risk0.limitations: Numeric/spatial/motion/safety parsers are lexical proxies, not human semantic judgements
